title: Borel selection of dominating hyperplanes
summary: We study a natural measurable selection problem for which the standard uniformisation theorems do not seem to apply directly, yet a Borel selector exists. More precisely, we consider families of finite dimensional functions that admit pointwise domination by affine functionals and ask whether such dominating functionals can be chosen in a Borel measurable way. We prove that this is indeed possible under semi-analytic regularity assumptions.
